# SAGMOTO

> SAGMOTO is a brand of Shaanxi Automobile Group (SAG), one of China's leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. SAGMOTO produces a comprehensive range of heavy-duty, medium-duty, and light-duty trucks including dump trucks, tractor trucks, cargo trucks, and special-purpose vehicles.

## Products

- [Heavy Duty Trucks](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/products.html?cat=heavy): E1st, Z3, E3, E9 - Heavy-duty trucks for mining, construction, and long-haul logistics
- [Medium Duty Trucks](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/products.html?cat=medium): E6, X6, X5 - Medium-duty trucks for regional transport and municipal applications
- [Light Duty Trucks](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/products.html?cat=light): i9, X9, X7 - Light-duty trucks for urban delivery and distribution
- [Off-Road Trucks](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/products.html?cat=offroad): X3s, Off-road Dump - Off-road and mining dump trucks
- [X1s Mining Dump Truck](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/x1s.html): 6x4 mining dump truck with Weichai WP10 350HP engine
- [New Energy Vehicles](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/new-energy.html): Electric trucks including i5 and i9 models

## Company

Shaanxi Fenghan Trading Co., Ltd. is the authorized export distributor for SAGMOTO trucks, serving markets in Africa, Middle East, Central Asia, and Russian-speaking regions. Based in Xi'an, China.

## Export Services

- FOB/CIF/CFR pricing to any global port
- Custom vehicle configuration and specifications
- Spare parts supply chain
- Technical training and after-sales support
- Multi-language sales support (English, Russian, Chinese)
